verdict.rationale: Local-network discovery and serverless connection are fair questions for a remote-desktop tool like AnyDesk, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents LAN host discovery, direct peer connections without vendor relay servers, or account-free connection. The CLI session-start and REST API items cover automation and account-registered clients, not this capability.

support.subject: As a power user, my devices find the host on the local network and connect without an account or a vendor server in between
